region.name: the Silverdales
region.blurb: Golden fields in the west, a long rocky coast and dark pine forest in the middle, and in the east goblin-infested Silverfell.

towns.name: Crownbury
towns.blurb: The royal city of the Silverdales: white walls, red roofs, and a castle flying the Queen's banners.

mayor.name: Mayor Quill
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed mayor with freckles and a crooked grin, a plum-coloured cloak, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Crownbury.
Anything you need, ask. The Queen's champion is welcome everywhere in Crownbury.

quest.title: The Midsummer Bonfire
offer: Our midsummer bonfire won't light. The wood is too damp. A Fire Flask would do it!
The Bubbling Pot in Murkmarsh sells Fire Flasks, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: Have you found a fire flask? The Bubbling Pot in Murkmarsh sells Fire Flasks.
done: Now we'll have a bonfire to remember!

shop.name: The Busy Bee

keeper.name: Lem
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Best prices in Crownbury! Well, the only prices in Crownbury.

workshop.name: Bryony's Workshop

keeper.name: Bryony
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Yvaine
npcs.avatar: small child with scabby knees and a pet frog in one pocket
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
Delphine's Outfitters in Hazelhollow sells a Boarhide Jerkin. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Sergeant Rue
npcs.avatar: grizzled town guard in a dented steel cap, leaning on a halberd
lines: Arms up, chin down, hit hard.
I can train you, for a few coins.
The Sunstone can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from two crystal shards and an ember crystal. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.

npcs.name: Granny Tilly
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: I remember the last time Everwyn needed a hero. You look taller than that one.
The Busy Bee in Crownbury sells crystal shards.

npcs.name: Miller Gus
npcs.avatar: dusty old miller with flour in the eyebrows
lines: Flour for all of Crownbury, and half of Murkmarsh too.
The Bog Beast prowls the road between Murkmarsh and Crownbury.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: a Greater Healing Draught.

towns.name: Silverfell
towns.blurb: Every hen-house is empty, and there is goblin scribble all over the town hall.

mayor.name: Warden Ellis
mayor.title: Warden
mayor.avatar: stout warden with freckles and a crooked grin, a plum-coloured cloak, and a gold chain of office
greeting: A hero! A real one! The Queen heard us!
Skrag has turned the old warren into a palace. They stole my chain of office. And my socks.

shop.name: The Last Candle

keeper.name: Beatrix
keeper.avatar: wood-elf shopkeeper with leaf-green braids and a quiver on her back

lines: Everyone else has gone, but somebody has to sell the potions.

workshop.name: The Last Forge

keeper.name: Hester
keeper.avatar: strong-armed smith in a leather apron, with soot on her nose and a hammer on her belt

lines: Everyone else has fled. The anvil's all yours.

npcs.name: Old Rufus
npcs.avatar: white-bearded grandfather on a bench, with a walking stick across his knees
lines: Skrag? Terrible business. I've seen worse. Not much worse, mind.
Goblinsbane, the Boarhide Jerkin and the Sunstone. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Sage
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: They stole my spear. I'm guarding the gate with a broom.
If you hear drums, hide the pies.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Hazelhollow
towns.blurb: Cottages with mossy roofs hide among the trees. Fireflies light the lanes at night.

mayor.name: Baroness Lark
mayor.title: Baroness
mayor.avatar: elegant baroness with silver hair in a bun, a patched but proud coat, and spectacles on a ribbon
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Hazelhollow.
The trees here are older than the kingdom. Be kind to them.

quest.title: A Bundle of Sea Charts for Millwick
offer: Would you carry this bundle of sea charts to Miller Wendel in Millwick? They need new charts before the autumn storms.
You'll be well paid for your trouble.
quest.reminder: Miller Wendel in Millwick is waiting for the bundle of sea charts.
done: The new charts! Now the boats can find their way home.

shop.name: Delphine's Outfitters

keeper.name: Delphine
keeper.avatar: brisk shopkeeper with a pencil behind one ear and a ledger under one arm

lines: Everything a traveller needs, and a few things they don't.

workshop.name: Aldous's Woodshop

keeper.name: Aldous
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: The grindstone sings when you pedal fast. Make it sing!

npcs.name: Ranger Saffron
npcs.avatar: hooded ranger with a longbow and a scar across one cheek
lines: The wild wears you down, if you let it.
I can toughen you up, if you've the coin.
The Busy Bee in Crownbury sells crystal shards.

npcs.name: Hazel
npcs.avatar: broad woodcutter in a checked shirt, with a long axe and sawdust everywhere
lines: The deep woods are no place to wander after dark.
There is an ember crystal hidden in the Old Chapel in Murkmarsh.

npcs.name: Jasper
npcs.avatar: cheerful minstrel in a feathered cap, with a fiddle under one arm
lines: I'm writing a song about you! So far it's mostly about your boots.
Captain Barnacle prowls the road between Stormhaven and Hazelhollow.

npcs.name: Crispin
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: My bees make the sweetest honey in the Silverdales.
Old Mother Spider prowls the road between Stonespire and Hazelhollow.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: a Goblin Trinket.

towns.name: Shellhaven
towns.blurb: A snug harbour behind a long stone pier, where the fishing boats come home at dusk.

mayor.name: Mayor Osric
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: small, brisk mayor with a neat white beard, a patched but proud coat, and spectacles on a ribbon
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Shellhaven.

quest.title: The Stubborn Weathervane
offer: The weathervane has stuck. The old priest says a jolt of lightning would free it.
The Busy Bee in Crownbury sells Thunder Vials, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: Have you found a thunder vial? The Busy Bee in Crownbury sells Thunder Vials.
done: Look at it spin! Thank you, Hero.

shop.name: The Gull & Oyster

keeper.name: Una
keeper.avatar: stubborn young shopkeeper with a smudged face and a lantern

lines: Rope, tar, lanterns and luck. Everything a sailor needs.

workshop.name: Sabine's Boatshed

keeper.name: Sabine
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Ropes, tar and a cauldron that has boiled a thousand crabs. Use it all.

npcs.name: Jory the Slightly Singed
npcs.avatar: small, round wizard in a patchwork robe covered in singe marks, with spectacles on a chain
lines: Tired of that face? I can change it. A little magic, a little gold.
Build, clothes, hair. Nothing I have not done a thousand times.

npcs.name: Fisher Bertram
npcs.avatar: weathered fisher in oilskins, with a net over one shoulder
lines: A quiet net and a calm sea. That's all I ask.
The fish are biting early this year. Something's got them nervous.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: a Greater Healing Draught!

towns.name: Murkmarsh
towns.blurb: Lantern-lit walkways wind between the houses over dark, still water. Frogs sing all night.

mayor.name: Mayor Rowena
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful mayor with braided red hair, a patched but proud coat, and a walking stick topped with a silver fox
greeting: A hero, in Murkmarsh! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Forgive the smell; it is the bog.

quest.title: The Bog Beast
offer: The Bog Beast has been prowling the road to Crownbury, frightening every traveller. Even the bravest carters turn back.
Beat the Bog Beast, and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: The Bog Beast is still out on the road to Crownbury.
done: The Bog Beast beaten? Then Murkmarsh owes you a great deal.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Bubbling Pot

keeper.name: Rosalind
keeper.avatar: brisk shopkeeper with a pencil behind one ear and a ledger under one arm

lines: Mind the jars. Some of them bite.

workshop.name: The Bog-Iron Forge

keeper.name: Agatha
keeper.avatar: strong-armed smith in a leather apron, with soot on her nose and a hammer on her belt

lines: Stir clockwise. Always clockwise. Trust me.

npcs.name: Old Greta
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: Eat something! You're all bones.
Only a Boarhide Jerkin can turn Skrag's poison. Delphine's Outfitters in Hazelhollow has one.

npcs.name: Fisher Ida
npcs.avatar: weathered fisher in oilskins, with a net over one shoulder
lines: The tide brings in all sorts. Pearls, if you look in the right places.
A quiet net and a calm sea. That's all I ask.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: an ember crystal.

towns.name: Stormhaven
towns.blurb: A lighthouse on the point, taverns on the quay, and a smell of salt and tar over everything.

mayor.name: Lady Ivy
mayor.title: Lady
mayor.avatar: small, brisk lady with a long golden plait, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a very large hat
greeting: Welcome to Stormhaven, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.

quest.title: Captain Barnacle
offer: Captain Barnacle has been prowling the road to Hazelhollow, frightening every traveller. Nobody dares to use that road any more.
Beat Captain Barnacle, and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Captain Barnacle is still out on the road to Hazelhollow.
done: Captain Barnacle beaten? Then Stormhaven owes you a great deal.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Gull & Oyster

keeper.name: Tam
keeper.avatar: cheerful bald merchant in a honey-coloured vest

lines: Rope, tar, lanterns and luck. Everything a sailor needs.

workshop.name: The Salt & Tar Shed

keeper.name: Zinnia
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Pedal hard and the bellows roar like the sea.

npcs.name: Herbalist Petra
npcs.avatar: herbalist in a green apron, with bundles of drying herbs hanging from the belt
lines: Every potion is a little poem, if you know how to read it.
Lessons are cheap. Not knowing is expensive.
Duchess Gwendolyn of Millwick is looking for a courier to Stormhaven.

npcs.name: Baker Cole
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: Fresh buns every morning, before the rooster is up.
The quickest road to Silverfell is the one from Stormhaven.

npcs.name: Old Egbert
npcs.avatar: ancient sailor in a salt-stained cap, with a telescope tucked under one arm
lines: Sixty years at sea, and I only fell overboard twice.
Goblins are terrified of fire and bright light.

spots.name: the Wrecked Boat
spots.text: Wedged under the rotten planks of an old boat: a Rusty Key.

towns.name: Stonespire
towns.blurb: A town of goatherds and stonecutters, stacked up a steep and windy slope.

mayor.name: Lady Morwenna
mayor.title: Lady
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful lady with silver hair in a bun, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and spectacles on a ribbon
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Stonespire.
Stonespire stands firm, and so do its people.

quest.title: Old Mother Spider
offer: Old Mother Spider has been prowling the road to Hazelhollow, frightening every traveller. Nobody dares to use that road any more.
Beat Old Mother Spider, and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Old Mother Spider is still out on the road to Hazelhollow.
done: Old Mother Spider beaten? Then Stonespire owes you a great deal.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Deep Delve

keeper.name: Bram
keeper.avatar: cheerful bald merchant in a honey-coloured vest

lines: Steel for heroes. Only the best, and the best isn't cheap.

workshop.name: The Stonecutter's Yard

keeper.name: Oswin
keeper.avatar: bearded woodworker with curls of shavings stuck to his jumper

lines: The best anvil this side of the mountains. Strike while it's hot!

npcs.name: Digby
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: Four hundred sheep, and I know every one by name.
The wind up here could blow the whiskers off a cat.

npcs.name: Guide Violet
npcs.avatar: wiry mountain guide with a coil of rope and wind-burned cheeks
lines: From here the road to Hazelhollow climbs, and keeps on climbing.
The pass is open, for now. Snow could close it any day.

spots.name: the Eagle's Nest
spots.text: High on the cliff, in an empty eagle's nest, lies a purse of 20 gold.

towns.name: Millwick
towns.blurb: A town of boatmen and millers, where the river is wide and slow and full of fish.

mayor.name: Duchess Gwendolyn
mayor.title: Duchess
mayor.avatar: elegant duchess with a long golden plait, a patched but proud coat, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Millwick welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Try the bread. Everyone in Millwick bakes.

quest.title: An Ore Sample for Stormhaven
offer: Would you carry this ore sample to Lady Ivy in Stormhaven? We have struck a new seam, and they want to see a sample.
Lady Ivy has Goblinsbane, and has promised it to whoever brings this.
quest.reminder: Lady Ivy in Stormhaven is waiting for the ore sample.
done: Beautiful! Look at that silver. Millwick will be rich.
I have kept Goblinsbane safe for years. It is yours now: go and put it to good use.

shop.name: The Golden Sheaf

keeper.name: Horace
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Best prices in Millwick! Well, the only prices in Millwick.

workshop.name: Elspeth's Workshop

keeper.name: Elspeth
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Farmer Florian
npcs.avatar: wiry old farmer in a straw hat, with a pitchfork over one shoulder
lines: The crows are bold this year. Bolder than the scarecrow, anyway.
The Old Chest in Millwick is locked. Its key was lost in the Wrecked Boat in Stormhaven years ago.

npcs.name: Miller Wendel
npcs.avatar: dusty old miller with flour in the eyebrows
lines: Hear that creak? That's the wheel. It's been creaking for forty years.
The mill never stops. Neither do I, most days.

spots.name: the Old Chest
spots.text: The Rusty Key turns with a screech. Inside the old chest: a Tome of Might!
spots.lockedText: A heavy chest sits in the corner, locked tight. The keyhole is caked with rust.

enemies.name: Giant Octopus
enemies.taunt: Eight long arms reach up out of a rock pool. One of them grabs your boot.

enemies.name: Pirate Deckhand
enemies.taunt: "Arr! Hand over yer valuables!"

enemies.name: Giant Crab
enemies.taunt: A crab the size of a cart clacks its claws.

enemies.name: Giant Spider
enemies.taunt: A spider as big as a pony drops from the branches on a silver thread.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Brown Bear
enemies.taunt: A bear rears up on its hind legs. It smells of honey and bad temper.

enemies.name: Thieving Gulls
enemies.taunt: A flock of gulls swoops down, screaming. One of them has your lunch.

enemies.name: Giant Toad
enemies.taunt: A toad the size of a barrel blinks at you, then flicks out a very long tongue.

enemies.name: Bog Lurker
enemies.taunt: Something scaly rises from the muck.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Angry Swan
enemies.taunt: A swan spreads its wings and hisses like a kettle. It wants the whole road to itself.

enemies.name: Goblin Raider
enemies.taunt: A goblin in a saucepan helmet shrieks and charges.

enemies.name: Goblin Wolf-Rider
enemies.taunt: A goblin riding a wolf bursts out of the bushes, whooping.

enemies.name: Cave Bats
enemies.taunt: A swarm of bats pours out of the rocks!

enemies.name: Stone Troll
enemies.taunt: A troll steps out from behind a boulder. No, wait: the boulder IS the troll.

enemies.name: Mountain Eagle
enemies.taunt: An eagle with wings as wide as a cart dives out of the sun.

enemies.name: Marsh Wisp
enemies.taunt: A pale light drifts closer, whispering your name.

enemies.name: Road Bandit
enemies.taunt: "Your gold or your life, traveler!"

enemies.name: the Bog Beast
enemies.taunt: The bog heaves. A great scaly beast rises, dripping weed and bad temper.
enemies.avatar: huge scaly swamp beast draped in pondweed, with lantern-yellow eyes

enemies.name: Captain Barnacle
enemies.taunt: "Captain Barnacle, at yer service! Now empty yer pockets."
enemies.avatar: barrel-chested pirate captain with a barnacle-crusted peg leg and a parrot

enemies.name: Old Mother Spider
enemies.taunt: Old Mother Spider lowers herself from the treetops on a rope of silk. Her eight eyes glitter.
enemies.avatar: spider as big as a cart, with grey-striped legs and a crown of cobwebs

enemies.name: Warchief Skrag
enemies.taunt: "Bow to the king of all the goblins, or I'll pinch your trousers!"
enemies.avatar: wiry goblin warchief with one enormous tooth, a saucepan helmet, and a spear decorated with spoons

hints.text: Lady Ivy in Stormhaven has Goblinsbane, and has promised it to whoever brings the ore sample from Millwick.
Duchess Gwendolyn of Millwick is looking for a courier to Stormhaven.
Delphine's Outfitters in Hazelhollow sells a Boarhide Jerkin. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.
Only a Boarhide Jerkin can turn Skrag's poison. Delphine's Outfitters in Hazelhollow has one.
The Sunstone can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from two crystal shards and an ember crystal. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.
The Busy Bee in Crownbury sells crystal shards.
There is an ember crystal hidden in the Old Chapel in Murkmarsh.
The Bog Beast prowls the road between Murkmarsh and Crownbury.
Captain Barnacle prowls the road between Stormhaven and Hazelhollow.
Old Mother Spider prowls the road between Stonespire and Hazelhollow.

challenge.title: The Goblin War
summons: Hero, thank you for coming so swiftly. Grave news has reached the throne.
A goblin horde led by Warchief Skrag has overrun Silverfell. They have stolen every pie, pot and pony in the town, and they want more.
The old songs name three things that can defeat Skrag: the sword Goblinsbane, a Boarhide Jerkin against poisoned darts, and the Sunstone, which goblins cannot bear to look at.
Gather all three, then go to Silverfell and face Skrag. Talk to everyone: somebody always knows something.
Take this purse and these draughts. My carriage will carry you to Crownbury. Everwyn is counting on you.

lair.name: the Goblin Warren
lair.text: A heap of stolen furniture piled up into a sort of palace, with a goblin flag on top.

victory: You hold up the Sunstone. The goblins shriek, cover their eyes, and run for their holes.
Goblinsbane throws sparks everywhere. Skrag drops a stolen crown and flees, howling.
The people of Silverfell get back every pie, pot and pony. Well, most of the pies.
